text:
Maya: quick preflight for Orbit pilot staging — customer is asking for p95 latency SLA in staging (private pilot) and we need cross-team signoff on sequencing and resourcing. Key asks: 99.9% uptime window, p95 <= 1.2s, canary/rollback plan. Who owns what?

Vik: I can own runtime config and canary logic. Need sample traces (seq len dist + qps). Do we have them?

Maya: uploaded traces and payloads here: https://drive.redwood/orbit-traces (cc: @Vik @Marta). Also attached the customer acceptance criteria doc.

Marta: Infra can allocate burst capacity but need exact slot counts and memory per-node. Preprovision lead time is ~72h in eu-west unless we use shared burst pool.

Samir: Security note — for private pilot we need KMS/HSM access review and an ingest/dataflow diagram before any keys are provisioned. Audit logging requirement (30d) will be enforced — that will affect storage.

Ashley: Product ops will own the launch checklist and canary gating. My initial checklist: e2e perf test pass, regression eval <=0.5%, canary at 5% traffic for 24h, rollback script, post-launch alerting.

RuntimeBot: DeployBot created staging cluster `orbit-pilot-staging` and scheduled a prewarm window for 2026-04-01T02:00Z. Ticket: #ORBIT-1234.

Vik: quick technical Q — can we run int8 quantized variant for the canary to save cost? Quality impact unknown, need eval harness.

Maya: proposal: run A/B during canary. 80% fp16, 20% int8. Run prompt-set eval; if quality delta > 0.5% (customer metric) rollback int8. Agreed?

Samir: Agree in principle, but need to run the eval in an environment with the same privacy constraints. Also we need NDA signed before sharing any customer keys with infra.

Marta: I'll provision 4 burst GPUs to start. If telemetry shows underprovisioning, we can request +2 but that will take 48-72h. Targeting p95 1.2s as Maya requested.

Ashley: I'll schedule SRE oncall for the 48h launch window and own the postmortem template.

Vik: autoscale snippet I'm planning to use (draft):
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  scale_policy:
    - metric: p95_latency_ms
      target: 1200
    - metric: cpu
      target: 0.7
```

Maya: thanks — a couple of open blockers: (1) Samir needs the dataflow diagram and NDA; (2) Marta needs final slot/memory numbers by EOD Thu; (3) Vik needs the trace histograms + prompt set for eval.

Samir: I'll DM NDA template and list the exact diagram fields we need.

Maya: let's converge in this thread by EOD tomorrow. If we hit any blocker, flag in #release-war-room. :thumbsup:

Vik: noted. I'll start on the canary eval harness and post initial numbers here later today.

Marta: will confirm GPU sizing and put a reservation request in infra queue.

Ashley: I'll create the launch checklist in the shared doc and assign owners.

RuntimeBot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance in eu-west on 2026-03-30 may affect prewarm windows.

Maya: thanks all — sync up tomorrow 9:30am PT if needed.
